title: Production ClayCode stable diagnostic identity differential on Ubuntu
goal: Wrap current production ClayCode parser/checker/runtime failures in the candidate structured diagnostic envelope and falsify its invariance/separation claims using real Ubuntu toolchain cases before any BASE credit.
required_tests: Emit stable rule_id/rule_revision/stage plus structured cause fields for current negative type/effect/parser/runtime cases.
Apply path relocation, whitespace/comment-only source shifts and rendering/message-template changes; occurrence fingerprint must remain stable when the diagnosed semantic cause is unchanged.
Create two distinct failures of one rule at different semantic anchors; fingerprints must differ.
Hold rule+anchor fixed and mutate a rule-declared semantic cause; fingerprints must differ.
Refactor checker/lowering implementation without changing predicate meaning; rule identity should remain stable while implementation provenance changes.
Change rule predicate/decision boundary intentionally and increment rule_revision; old/new fingerprints must not compare as the same diagnostic occurrence.
Run WP11 fuzz and WP12 corpus generator using structured identity; measure duplicate collapse, false-new rate, false-same rate and mutation localization versus text/span and rule-only baselines.
For effect/runtime failures, verify diagnostic records never serialize or confer bearer authority and cannot authorize an effect.
